verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable open-source database like Weaviate. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The cited items cover search, multi-tenancy, replication, backups, deployment and MCP, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
